newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trelleborg forecasts 1 bln SKR profit in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Trelleborg forecasts 1 bln SKR profit in 1996.

text.p: Swedish mining group Trelleborg on Friday said the fourth quarter of 1996 would be similar to the third quarter and forecast a profit after financial items of one billion crowns ($151.7 million) for the full year.
"For the fourth quarter we predict a result of the same size as the third quarter which means a full year result before tax of around one billion crowns," Trelleborg said in a statement.
This compared to a profit after financial items and before tax of 3.5 billion crowns for calendar 1995.
Analysts had forecast a full year profit of 1.18 billion crowns.
But the company's results for the first nine months of 1996 also fell below expectations.
Trelleborg posted a profit after financial items of 837 million crowns, lower than a market consensus of 891 million crowns.
This was a sharp drop from the corresponding period a year ago when the company posted a profit after financial items of 3.17 billion crowns.
The company pointed out in its report that the 1995 nine month figure had included a boost of 1.96 billion crowns from the sale of share in Falconbridge Ltd.
Trelleborg's share price slipped on the result. At 1200 GMT it was 1.5 crowns lower at 85.50 after trading 0.5 crowns lower throughout the morning.
Sales for the 1996's first nine months reached 15.29 billion crowns compared to 15.82 billion a year earlier.
